caption: The drawing features a single, tall, flared glass vase or drinking glass situated in the center of a plain, beige background. The object is rendered with detailed attention to shading and reflections, giving it a three-dimensional appearance. The glass is primarily red, with lighter and darker shades of red and some orange tones accentuating its curved surfaces. There are highlights in white and pinkish hues indicating reflections on the glossy surface of the glass, especially near the rim and along the body. The glass has a narrow base that flares out into a wide, circular foot. The background is uniformly beige without any additional objects or patterns, and the artist’s signature, “Stewart,” appears near the base of the glass on the lower right side of the composition.
title: Vase (Red Opaque Glass)
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
